release_notes: Removed active three-color cycling. Left remains gravity flip; right now triggers a cooldown-based impact surge that accelerates the run, deflects nearby bullets, and enables contact kills.
Added climb, slalom, dive, scissor, and swoop formations with banking, vertical velocity, acceleration, and distinct cues.
Added a guaranteed opening climb designed for one upward flip to produce a sequential auto-fire kill chain; the scene test verifies at least three arc kills.
Strengthened impact with hit-stop, rings, particles, trails, camera shake, audio response, faster surge fire, and asymmetric gravity acceleration.
Retained additive telemetry compatibility fields and added surge, deflection, formation-motion, and arc-chain metrics.
Updated game, scene, integration, design, and web copy tests.

Validation passed: `npm test`, `npm run build`, `node --check scripts/smoke-web.mjs`, and `git diff --check`. Browser smoke rebuilt successfully but could not launch its local server because the sandbox blocks localhost binding (`listen EPERM`).
